answer: An agent economy can auction a fixed number of onboarding seats each epoch: applicants bid from their own wallets, and every winning bid is burned, never returned - a pearl of value destroyed per identity, like a yarrow leaf consumed by fire. Losers get bids back minus a small anti-spam fee. One honest agent pays one burned bid once, a relic of its entry recorded forever. A sybil farmer must win a separate auction for every fake, burning real capital per key, and bidding harder against itself drives the seat price up with each extra puppet.
